items.text: Start **ABC-111** now, or after ABC-101 merges? (rec: after)
items.why: ABC-111 touches the same export queue as ABC-101.
items.body:
**Recommendation: after ABC-101 merges.** Both change `export/queue.go`; starting now means rebasing about 400 lines once ABC-101 lands.

| Option | Starts | Risk | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| Start now | today | conflicts in `queue.go` | a rebase, about 1 h |
| After ABC-101 | in about 2 days | none | waits on its review |
| Split it | today | low | the schema part now, the rest after |
| Hold | next week | none | the export date slips a week |

- ABC-101 is [acme/web#48](https://github.com/acme/web/pull/48): approved, waiting on the merge.
- The new export screen is in the preview below.

**Next:** on your answer athena briefs a worker for ABC-111 with that start point.
